panels.title: HVC state

panels.description: Which state the HVC was in over the selected time range. Each state has its own row, in startup order; a coloured bar shows when the HVC was in it (same colours as the HVC state box). A normal startup steps down the rows from Reset to Monitoring, and the bar that reaches the right edge is the state it's in now. A FAULT bar starts where the step it faulted in ends. The grey 'No HVC data' row covers the times nothing arrived from the HVC (car off, HVC not sending, or before telemetry started). Hover for exact times.

targets.query:
import "array"
base = from(bucket: "CAN_prod")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "HVC")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "HVCState")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => "${car}" == "All" or r["car"] == "${car}")
  |> toInt()
  |> group()

// every state change (so even 1 s steps show)
changes = base
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> duplicate(column: "_value", as: "s")
  |> difference(columns: ["_value"], keepFirst: true)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not exists r._value or r._value != 0)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "s"])
// gaps: time windows (at least the board timeout, 'board_timeout_s', so normal gaps between
// messages don't count) with no message from the HVC get a -1 (No HVC data) point at their start.
// Windows start at the start of the time range; the last one is cut short by the end of the range,
// so it only counts if it's a full window long.
minWin = int(v: float(v: "${board_timeout_s}") * 1000000000.0)
win = if int(v: v.windowPeriod) > minWin then int(v: v.windowPeriod) else minWin
off = int(v: v.timeRangeStart) % win
gaps = base
  |> aggregateWindow(every: duration(v: win), offset: duration(v: off), fn: count, createEmpty: true, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == 0 and int(v: r._time) <= int(v: v.timeRangeStop) - win)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, s: -1}))
// after a gap: the first message of every window, at its own time, so a state that continues
// after a gap starts again exactly when its message arrived (never earlier)
firsts = base
  |> window(every: duration(v: win), offset: duration(v: off))
  |> first()
  |> window(every: inf)
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, s: r._value}))
// the current state again at the end, so its bar reaches the right edge
now = base
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: v.timeRangeStop, s: r._value}))

merged = union(tables: [changes, gaps, firsts])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  // drop repeats, keep each change
  |> duplicate(column: "s", as: "_value")
  |> difference(columns: ["_value"], keepFirst: true)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not exists r._value or r._value != 0)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "s"])

// nothing from the HVC in the time range: every row still shows, 'No HVC data' across the width
hasRec = base |> count() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
hasData = exists hasRec._value and hasRec._value > 0
empty = array.from(rows: [{_time: v.timeRangeStart, s: -1}, {_time: v.timeRangeStop, s: -1}])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not hasData)

union(tables: [merged, now, empty])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  // one column (row) per state: the state's number while in it, a lane value otherwise
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      "  No HVC data": if r.s == -1 then -1 else -100,
      "  Reset": if r.s == 0 then 0 else -101,
      "  TEL startup": if r.s == 1 then 1 else -100,
      "  MST handshake": if r.s == 2 then 2 else -101,
      "  MST status check": if r.s == 3 then 3 else -100,
      "  Fans power-up": if r.s == 4 then 4 else -101,
      "  HV connect": if r.s == 5 then 5 else -100,
      "  Discharge relay": if r.s == 6 then 6 else -101,
      "  Motor precharge": if r.s == 7 then 7 else -100,
      "  MPPT precharge": if r.s == 8 then 8 else -101,
      "  Close LLIM": if r.s == 9 then 9 else -100,
      "  Close HLIM": if r.s == 10 then 10 else -101,
      "  LV power-up": if r.s == 11 then 11 else -100,
      "  Monitoring": if r.s == 12 then 12 else -101,
      "  FAULT": if r.s == 13 then 13 else -100}))

panels.description: The HVC's fault flags (HvcFault 0x321). Any red tile = the HVC is in FAULT; flags stay set until the HVC is reset. E-Stop = ESTOP pin. IMD GPIO / MST GPIO = the IMD / MASTERBOARD_FAULT pin went high. MST CAN = MST's heartbeat reports an error, fault or warning (see the MST panel for which). // Otherwise the value is "min_max" (e.g. 110_120); a typed "min,max" works too.
sel = "${pack_v_range}"
parts = strings.split(v: strings.replaceAll(v: sel, t: ",", u: "_"), t: "_")
isAuto = length(arr: parts) != 2

dMax = if hasData then mxRec._value else 0.0

hi = if isAuto then mid + half else float(v: parts[1])

    {_time: v.timeRangeStop, bound: "axis min", _value: lo},

import "dict"
import "array"
import "regexp"
import "strings"

// MST sends 7 bits per module (ModuleWarnsAndFaults0-3, 0x230-0x233): 3 warnings, 4 faults
what = dict.fromList(pairs: [
    {key: "FaultOverVolt", value: "over-voltage"},
    {key: "FaultUnderVolt", value: "under-voltage"},
    {key: "FaultOverTemp", value: "over-temp"},
    {key: "FaultUnderTemp", value: "under-temp"},
    {key: "WarnHighVolt", value: "high-voltage warning"},
    {key: "WarnLowVolt", value: "low-voltage warning"},
    {key: "WarnHighTemp", value: "high-temp warning"}
])
kindOrder = dict.fromList(pairs: [
    {key: "FaultOverVolt", value: 0},
    {key: "FaultUnderVolt", value: 1},
    {key: "FaultOverTemp", value: 2},
    {key: "FaultUnderTemp", value: 3},
    {key: "WarnHighVolt", value: 4},
    {key: "WarnLowVolt", value: 5},
    {key: "WarnHighTemp", value: 6}
])

status = from(bucket: "CAN_prod")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "MST")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] =~ /^Mod[0-9]+(Warn|Fault)[A-Za-z]+$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => "${car}" == "All" or r["car"] == "${car}")
  |> last()
  |> toInt()
  |> group()

nAllRec = status |> count() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
nAll = if exists nAllRec._value then nAllRec._value else 0

bad = status
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      kind = regexp.findString(r: /(Warn|Fault)[A-Za-z]+$/, v: r._field)
      return {
          mod: int(v: strings.trimSuffix(v: strings.trimPrefix(v: r._field, prefix: "Mod"), suffix: kind)),
          ko: dict.get(dict: kindOrder, key: kind, default: 9),
          fault: if strings.hasPrefix(v: kind, prefix: "Fault") then 1 else 0,
          txt: dict.get(dict: what, key: kind, default: kind)}
  })
  |> group(columns: ["mod"])
  |> sort(columns: ["ko"])
  |> reduce(identity: {t: "", f: 0},
      fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
          t: accumulator.t + ", " + r.txt,
          f: if r.fault > accumulator.f then r.fault else accumulator.f}))
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      Name: "M" + string(v: r.mod + 1) + " · " + strings.trimPrefix(v: r.t, prefix: ", "),
      o: r.mod,
      _value: if r.f == 1 then 1.0 else 2.0}))

nBadRec = bad |> count() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
nBad = if exists nBadRec._value then nBadRec._value else 0

ok = array.from(rows: [{Name: "All 32 modules OK", o: -1, _value: 0.0}])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => nAll > 0 and nBad == 0)

// nothing from MST's module status messages: one grey "no data" tile
nodata = array.from(rows: [{Name: "Module status: no data", o: -2, _value: -999999.0}])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => nAll == 0)

union(tables: [bad, ok, nodata])
  |> sort(columns: ["o"])
  |> keep(columns: ["Name", "_value"])
